cap_three_cells_per_column.program:
(rule! (lambda (g) (transpose (map (lambda (column)
      (let* ((values (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) column))
             (picked (take values (min 3 (length values))))) (append (make-list (- (rows g) (length picked)) 0) picked))) (transpose g)))))

repeat_until_stable.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let loop ((state (gravity g "down")) (remaining (* (rows g) (cols g))))
    (let ((groups (filter (lambda (o) (>= (obj-size o) 3)) (objects state 0))))
      (if (or (empty? groups) (= remaining 0)) state
        (loop (gravity (erase-cells state (flatmap obj-cells groups) 0) "down") (- remaining 1)))))))
